items.title: Jon Small, Drummer In Early Billy Joel Bands, Has Died
items.summary: Jon Small, who played drums in Billy Joel's early bands the Hassles and Atilla and later became an accomplished director of music videos and concert films, has died. Joel announced his passing in a social media post today, and a death announcement circulating on social media notes he died Friday. His funeral will be held on Sept. 9 in Great Neck, New York. No cause of death has been listed. The post Jon Small, Drummer In Early Billy Joel Bands, Has Died appeared first on Stereogum .
